discovery_policy: Metadata-only, targeted PubMed E-Utilities searches; top 150 relevance-ranked PMIDs per stratum; four batched PubMed EFetch metadata calls; no baseline download.

screening_contract.accepted_bytes: PMC OAI-PMH metadataPrefix=pmc JATS XML only; retained as deterministic gzip under durable external evidence root.
screening_contract.full_text_retrieval: Only after candidate acceptance with article/version-specific CC0 or CC BY rights evidence from PMC OAI-PMH front matter.
screening_contract.nonaccepted_full_text: Never retrieved. Metadata-only candidates rejected before JATS retrieval.
screening_contract.unretained_metadata: PubMed abstracts and the broad query result IDs are transient and are not included in the public registry.
